title: REWARD MODELS INHERIT VALUE BIASES FROM PRETRAINING

bias_targets.methodology: Using an exhaustive token search method to rank words from the "Big Two" psycholinguistic dictionary (measuring agency vs. communion) based on reward model scores and base model log probabilities in response to value-laden prompts.

Evaluating token rankings for words from the Moral Foundations Dictionary 2 (measuring authority, care, fairness, loyalty, and sanctity) using exhaustive token search on responses to positively and negatively framed prompts.
